entities.name: SDHAF2 / Sdh5
observations: The 158-aa query exactly matches reviewed Danio rerio UniProt A3KP74; annotation identifies a mitochondrial succinate dehydrogenase assembly factor required for covalent FAD attachment to SDHA.
Query carries Pfam Sdh5 domain PF03937.22 at residues 61–136 (i-Evalue 6.4e-26).
UniProt annotation associates this protein with mitochondrial respiratory complex II assembly and succinate-to-ubiquinone electron transport.

entities.name: Complex II assembly
observations: Sdh5/SDHAF2 is annotated as required for assembly of mitochondrial succinate dehydrogenase (respiratory complex II), including SDHA flavinylation.
